headline: Late Drama Sees France Beat Iraq 3-0
whyCareReason: A crucial group stage result in Group I that leaves standing tables dramatically altered.
teaser: Tactical discipline and clinical finishes defined this Matchday 3 encounter. Here is how France and Iraq fought out their group stage clash.
story:
Under the bright lights in Los Angeles, France and Iraq took to the pitch on 2026-06-25 for a highly anticipated Matchday 3 fixture. The tension in the stadium was palpable, reflecting the immense stakes of the tournament.

With both managers deploying disciplined defensive setups, space was at a premium. Kylian Mbappé showed moments of brilliance for France, while Aymen Hussein was the creative heartbeat for Iraq. In the end, a few decisive moments settled the score at 3-0, giving fans plenty to talk about.

For the victors, this result represents a massive step toward the knockout rounds. For the defeated, it is back to the drawing board to save their World Cup campaign before the group stage concludes.
stakes: With Group I wide open, this matchday 3 encounter holds massive implications for both France and Iraq as they look to secure a place in the knockout rounds.
rivalryAngle: The footballing connection between France and Iraq adds an extra layer of emotion to this fixture, making it a must-watch for fans.
funFacts: France are affectionately known as the Les Bleus.
Iraq are affectionately known as the Lions of Mesopotamia.
